note: Tasks are phrased the way a user would phrase them, deliberately NOT reusing the catalog's own description wording — otherwise the eval measures retrieval of its own phrasing rather than comprehension. Expected ids follow the module.verb_object convention and must be reconciled against the real catalog after extraction; `pnpm eval` reports any expected id that is missing from the index rather than scoring it as a miss.
pairs: send now vs schedule a campaign
create a list vs add someone to a list
delete a contact vs unsubscribe a contact
